headline: Citing the 'Deep State,' Trump overhauls the intelligence community
context: The catastrophic 9/11 attacks forced the intelligence community to radically revamp its ways of doing business. Now, critics say, President Trump is dismantling much of what was built since then.

sources.name: NPR
